protocol.worker: Five alternating old/new/pinned-llama groups, two warm requests per process; measured third request with synchronized graph-phase trace.
protocol.http_sse: Same candidate binary, two retained servers, serial requests, two warmup pairs then five alternating pairs per mode/case.
protocol.conditions: Qwen3.5-2B Q4_0 GGUF unchanged, native SwiGLU 0, upload 0, chunk 128, final-prefill logits 1, last-FFN-row 0/1, identical prompt IDs and generated counts.
protocol.limits: Each campaign <=900 s, each request <=180 s. No timing sample excluded.

diagnostic_trace.interpretation: Shader compilation and full-state hashing contaminate interval; local indication only, not shipping timing.

worker_raw.note: Startup is construction-to-ready with OS file cache uncontrolled. Graph phase includes synchronization; not shader-only time.

http_sse_raw.note: Two retained servers, serial requests, two warmups per mode, five alternating pairs. SSE counts are established by identical text and finish against the counted nonstream response; SSE does not expose usage.

decision: Retain selectable opt-in, default off. Prefill graph improves in 4/5 worker pairs per case; whole-request HTTP/SSE benefit is mixed and a no-op negative control exhibits drift. No llama.cpp request win claimed.
uncertainty: Desktop activity, macOS scheduling and power state were uncontrolled. Startup uses OS cache and is not disk-cold. Diagnostic Metal resource allocation is not physical RAM. Decode path is unchanged; decode timing differences are host noise or contention, not attributable to this flag.
